manifest.title: Medium 阶段配置选择：中文分析

blocks.body: # Medium 阶段配置选择：中文分析

## 核心结论：最省电的配置，不一定让全队最快完成充电

当前结果给出了 30 个条件下的配置选择。风向、风力、队形和间距共同对应不同的逐位置耗电率；充电位数量决定这些耗电差异如何转化为全队完成充电的时间。因此没有一种 formation 在所有条件下都最优，也不能只根据全队平均耗电或某一架无人机的耗电判断。

在 120 组跨 formation 比较中，112 组的选择既使总时间更短，又具有更低的全队标准化 SOC 消耗；另有 8 组总时间更短，但全队标准化消耗更高。后者的优势在于充电负担的分布。本版仅将已完成的分析整理成中文，不改动原始数据、耗电率或最优配置。

## 比较前提：统一 Medium 起点后，再比较配置

分析使用此前 250 cm 前进实验：134 次真实飞行中，有 630 条可用的无人机–飞行 Medium 记录，汇总为 55 组队形、间距与风况组合，每组包含五个位置的耗电率。不加入 wind tunnel 仿真数据。四组安全排除组合仍排除；低强度侧风的 Column 50 cm 因缺少合格真实数据也不参与。

先按每块电池自己的 Medium 区间筛选并通过 Bideal 标准化，再平移到统一的 Bideal 75% 起点；这属于前置处理，不是函数输入。比较段固定 250 cm、25 秒，耗电率单位为 Bideal 百分点/分钟。全队标准化消耗指五架无人机 SOC 下降量之和，不是直接测量的焦耳或瓦时。

总时间为固定段飞行时间加上全队完成充电的时间。充电沿用既有指数模型：0→99% 为 90 分钟，目标 99%；充电位相同且到达时可用，不中断充电，不计等待期间耗电和配置切换代价。因此报告里的总时间是该模型下的计算结果，不是现场实测充电时间，也不是整个多段任务的全局最短时间。

## Low / High 表示风力，不表示电池阶段

论文中用 low wind、high wind 分别对应原来的 Lv1、Lv2；这里写作低强度风、高强度风。它们是实验风扇档位，不换算成未测量的 m/s。电量区间称 Medium SOC。队形拼写用 Echelon，保留历史代码键 echalon。

## 充电位数量改变，最优配置也会改变

下面每行是一种风况，每列为 1–5 个可用充电位。表中给出在现有安全且有真实数据的配置中，使计算总时间最短的 formation 与间距。同一行出现不同队形，并不是气动环境改变，而是同一耗电分布在不同充电排程下的效果改变。

## 论文 Decision Map 与本版结果保持一致

已有论文图覆盖同样的 30 个格子，横轴是充电位数量，纵轴是风向及 low/high 风力，每格直接标注队形和间距。PDF、SVG、600 dpi PNG 和英文图注仍保留。本次只增加中文解读，不改论文图中的决策。

## 函数如何从耗电率得到最短总时间

对于候选配置 c，第 i 个位置的耗电率为 rᵢ，则到达 SOC 为 sᵢ = 75 − 25rᵢ/60。既有充电模型给出单机充电时间 qᵢ = [5400/ln(100)] ln(100−sᵢ)，单位为秒。把五个充电任务分配给 k 个充电位，使最晚完成的充电位尽早完成，再加上固定的 25 秒飞行时间。

**F(充电位数量, 风向, 风力) = 计算总时间最短的 configuration。**

在本数据的单机充电时间范围内，把五个任务从短到长排序为 q(1) 到 q(5)，可以这样理解：

- 1 位：五个任务总和。
- 2 位：三个最短任务合用一位，另外两个合用另一位；前一组决定完成时间。
- 3 位：最长任务单独一位；另外四个优化配对，比较两组较长者。
- 4 位：两个最短任务共享一位，其余各一位。
- 5 位：所有无人机并行充电，最长单机任务决定完成时间。

全部 275 个候选得分已用穷举分组核对。中间三个简化描述依赖当前任务时长接近的特点，不能直接用于任意不相等的实时 SOC。

## 气动解释要连接到旋翼负担，再连接到耗电

解释队形差异时，需要同时考虑机体受风、旋翼来流以及维持姿态和路径的修正，而不能只说“被前机挡住，所以更省电”。遮挡可能减少机体阻力，但前机尾流也会改变后机产生推力的效率，两种作用可能相互抵消。相关队形研究中，单独考虑阻力和加入旋翼气动力后的排名就不同。[R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766)

单机风洞和飞行研究支持风、姿态与电机负担共同影响功耗；邻近飞行研究支持相对位置改变扰动力与控制需求。本文用这些机理解释测得的耗电分布，数值排名仍由自己的真实耗电率与充电计算决定，不照搬其他机型或固定翼 V 队形的结论。[R1](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20160007399) [R2](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/1756829320923565) [R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992)

## 抗风既涉及推力，也涉及产生推力的效率

在近似稳定、等高飞行中，无人机需同时支撑重量并平衡水平气动力。忽略机体竖直气动力时，有 T cosθ = mg、T sinθ = D。水平阻力增大需要更多总推力；但来流也会改变旋翼诱导功率，因此总功耗不是仅由阻力大小决定。[R1](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20160007399) [R2](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/1756829320923565)

## 前机尾流接触后机旋翼的位置很重要

直接下洗流与尾流边缘的作用不同。旋翼台架研究中，串列下洗流会降低后方旋翼推力，而合适的斜向偏移可改善旋翼载荷。为了维持相同的必要推力，电机需要不同的转速和功率。这就是横向错位不仅仅是“拉远一点”的原因。[R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

## 纠偏动作也体现在最终耗电中

不均匀的气动力和力矩会引起差动电机调节，用来维持姿态、位置和飞行路径。因此真实耗电率综合反映了推进和控制修正，不能把两架无人机的耗电差全部当成单一阻力差。[R2](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/1756829320923565) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992)

## 顺风不能简单理解成逆风耗电的相反数

相对空气速度等于地速减去风速。固定地速为 0.1 m/s 时，如果顺风速度超过地速，纵向相对来流会反向，无人机还需要避免被吹得过快。这会改变上下游关系以及尾流与相邻旋翼相遇的位置，所以不能把逆风下某个编号的“领航机”角色直接用于顺风。[R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3)

## 75 cm 不一定比 50 cm 更省电

增大距离可能减轻直接尾流干扰，也可能削弱有利遮挡，或使旋翼离开较有利的来流区域。因此间距的作用取决于队形和风向，不能设置“间距更大必然更优”的统一规则。[R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766)

## P1–P5 是记录位置，不等于固定的气动角色

本报告采用旧前进实验耗电表的 P1–P5，不把新 wind tunnel 的 Mission Pad 布局套回旧数据。不同队形的同一位置编号，未必都是最迎风或最受遮挡的位置。以下将数据比较与布局机理对应起来，但不把未单独测量的阻力、尾流功率和纠偏功率拆成额外实验数值。

## 低强度逆风：为什么配置会这样变化

低强度逆风下，1–4 个充电位选择 Front 75 cm，5 个充电位改为 Echelon 75 cm。Front 的五个位置耗电率为 [1.639, 10.830, 0.967, 2.468, 7.344] Bideal 百分点/分钟，其中 P1、P3、P4 较低，利于减少共享充电位上的任务时间。但 P2 的 10.830 较高；五个充电位时，一机一位，低耗电位置不能再缩短 P2 自身的充电时间。Echelon 75 cm 将最大耗电率降至 8.395，因此取代 Front。一个具体对照是：Echelon 的全队标准化消耗之和反而较高，但五位充电的总时间比 Front 少 41.02 秒。

### 1 个充电位：front 75 cm

选择 **front 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **322.08 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 75 cm 少 219.51 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是五架无人机充电时间的总和；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P2、P3、P4、P5。

从布局看，Front 横向展开，避免无人机沿来流方向连续串列；相较 Column，少了连续的前后机尾流相遇，同时横向距离仍会改变相邻旋翼的来流。遮挡减少的阻力与尾流造成的推力变化需要一起考虑。

与 echelon 75 cm 相比，front 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 219.51 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 9.687 个百分点，对方为 14.601 个百分点，较低 33.7%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 321.66 分钟；对方承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 325.32 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 2 个充电位：front 75 cm

选择 **front 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **190.77 分钟**，比第二名 front 50 cm 少 169.77 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是共享充电位上三个较短任务的总时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P3、P4。

从布局看，Front 横向展开，避免无人机沿来流方向连续串列；相较 Column，少了连续的前后机尾流相遇，同时横向距离仍会改变相邻旋翼的来流。遮挡减少的阻力与尾流造成的推力变化需要一起考虑。

与 column 50 cm 相比，front 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 189.94 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 9.687 个百分点，对方为 15.014 个百分点，较低 35.5%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P3+P4，充电 190.35 分钟；对方承担 P1+P4+P5，充电 193.51 分钟。这组比较同时改变了队形和间距；另附相同间距的比较表。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 3 个充电位：front 75 cm

选择 **front 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **128.80 分钟**，比第二名 column 50 cm 少 73.28 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是优化分组后，两组双机充电任务中较长的一组；最后完成的充电位承担 P3、P5。

从布局看，Front 横向展开，避免无人机沿来流方向连续串列；相较 Column，少了连续的前后机尾流相遇，同时横向距离仍会改变相邻旋翼的来流。遮挡减少的阻力与尾流造成的推力变化需要一起考虑。

与 column 50 cm 相比，front 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 73.28 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 9.687 个百分点，对方为 15.014 个百分点，较低 35.5%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P3+P5，充电 128.38 分钟；对方承担 P4+P5，充电 129.60 分钟。这组比较同时改变了队形和间距；另附相同间距的比较表。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 4 个充电位：front 75 cm

选择 **front 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **127.07 分钟**，比第二名 front 50 cm 少 94.77 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是两个最短任务共享充电位的时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P3。

从布局看，Front 横向展开，避免无人机沿来流方向连续串列；相较 Column，少了连续的前后机尾流相遇，同时横向距离仍会改变相邻旋翼的来流。遮挡减少的阻力与尾流造成的推力变化需要一起考虑。

与 column 50 cm 相比，front 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 101.33 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 9.687 个百分点，对方为 15.014 个百分点，较低 35.5%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P3，充电 126.65 分钟；对方承担 P1+P5，充电 128.34 分钟。这组比较同时改变了队形和间距；另附相同间距的比较表。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 5 个充电位：echelon 75 cm

选择 **echelon 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **65.88 分钟**，比第二名 vee 75 cm 少 27.19 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是最长的单机充电时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P4。

Echelon 在前后错开的同时增加横向偏移，可使后方旋翼避开部分直接下洗流，并改变其接触尾流核心或边缘的方式。这会改变维持推力所需的电机输出以及各位置之间的负担分布。

与 vee 75 cm 相比，echelon 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 27.19 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 14.601 个百分点，对方为 17.351 个百分点，较低 15.9%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P4，充电 65.47 分钟；对方承担 P5，充电 65.92 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

## 高强度逆风：为什么配置会这样变化

高强度逆风下，Echelon 75 cm 在 1 个和 5 个充电位时最优，Front 50 cm 在 2 个和 4 个时最优，Echelon 50 cm 在 3 个时最优。Echelon 75 cm 的最大耗电率为 8.281，低于 Front 50 cm 的 11.067，因此有利于五位并行充电。Front 50 cm 的 P3、P5 分别只有 1.342、3.993，利于两个或四个充电位下组合较短的任务。三位充电时，Echelon 50 cm 的两组共享任务组合更有利。这不是风在不同充电位数量下改变了，而是排程目标对同一耗电分布的评价改变了。

### 1 个充电位：echelon 75 cm

选择 **echelon 75 cm**，计算总时间为 **324.11 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 50 cm 少 42.77 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是五架无人机充电时间的总和；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P2、P3、P4、P5。

Echelon 在前后错开的同时增加横向偏移，可使后方旋翼避开部分直接下洗流，并改变其接触尾流核心或边缘的方式。这会改变维持推力所需的电机输出以及各位置之间的负担分布。

与 front 50 cm 相比，echelon 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 49.13 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 12.314 个百分点，对方为 13.621 个百分点，较低 9.6%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 323.69 分钟；对方承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 324.51 分钟。这组比较同时改变了队形和间距；另附相同间距的比较表。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 2 个充电位：front 50 cm

选择 **front 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **193.16 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 50 cm 少 14.63 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是共享充电位上三个较短任务的总时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P3、P5。

从布局看，Front 横向展开，避免无人机沿来流方向连续串列；相较 Column，少了连续的前后机尾流相遇，同时横向距离仍会改变相邻旋翼的来流。遮挡减少的阻力与尾流造成的推力变化需要一起考虑。

与 echelon 50 cm 相比，front 50 cm 的计算总时间减少 14.63 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 13.621 个百分点，对方为 13.428 个百分点，较高 1.4%。这组比较中，总时间优势来自充电负担的分布，而不是全队耗电更少。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P3+P5，充电 192.74 分钟；对方承担 P1+P2+P3，充电 192.99 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 3 个充电位：echelon 50 cm

选择 **echelon 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **129.44 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 75 cm 少 14.44 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是优化分组后，两组双机充电任务中较长的一组；最后完成的充电位承担 P2、P3。

Echelon 在前后错开的同时增加横向偏移，可使后方旋翼避开部分直接下洗流，并改变其接触尾流核心或边缘的方式。这会改变维持推力所需的电机输出以及各位置之间的负担分布。

与 vee 50 cm 相比，diamond 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 11.98 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 15.047 个百分点，对方为 15.046 个百分点，较高 0.008%。这组比较中，总时间优势来自充电负担的分布，而不是全队耗电更少。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P2+P3，充电 130.10 分钟；对方承担 P1+P5，充电 130.30 分钟。这组比较同时改变了队形和间距；另附相同间距的比较表。 [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.06766) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 4 个充电位：vee 50 cm

选择 **vee 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **128.31 分钟**，比第二名 column 75 cm 少 61.77 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是两个最短任务共享充电位的时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P2、P5。

顺风下，Vee 两臂相对于来流的前后关系与逆风不同，遮挡及尾流接触位置随之变化。这里还必须结合 P2 接近零的整数 SOC 差值理解：这个小数值参与计算，但不是该位置不消耗实际能量。

## 高强度顺风：为什么配置会这样变化

高强度顺风下，Column 50 cm 在 1–4 个充电位时最优，5 个时改为 Echelon 50 cm。Column 的 P3、P4、P5 为 0.961、2.849、5.253，利于降低共享任务组合的时间；但 P1 为 12.579，是明显的高负担位置。五位充电时，Echelon 的最大耗电率降至 9.547，相比 Column 总时间减少 50.04 秒。需要区分这一对照与第二名：Echelon 相比 Diamond 75 cm 只快 0.68 秒，因此它与 Diamond 在当前计算中非常接近。

### 1 个充电位：column 50 cm

选择 **column 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **323.33 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 50 cm 少 165.16 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是五架无人机充电时间的总和；最后完成的充电位承担 P1、P2、P3、P4、P5。

Column 在纵向形成连续遮挡，也使各位置依次受到前方机体与尾流影响。遮挡与不均匀旋翼来流共同作用，可以形成部分位置负担低、个别位置负担高的分布；顺风时不能照搬逆风的领航机解释。

与 echelon 50 cm 相比，column 50 cm 的计算总时间减少 165.16 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 11.432 个百分点，对方为 15.174 个百分点，较低 24.7%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 322.92 分钟；对方承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 325.67 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 2 个充电位：column 50 cm

选择 **column 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **192.00 分钟**，比第二名 vee 50 cm 少 149.12 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是共享充电位上三个较短任务的总时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P3、P4、P5。

Column 在纵向形成连续遮挡，也使各位置依次受到前方机体与尾流影响。遮挡与不均匀旋翼来流共同作用，可以形成部分位置负担低、个别位置负担高的分布；顺风时不能照搬逆风的领航机解释。

与 vee 50 cm 相比，column 50 cm 的计算总时间减少 149.12 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 11.432 个百分点，对方为 16.553 个百分点，较低 30.9%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P3+P4+P5，充电 191.58 分钟；对方承担 P1+P3+P4，充电 194.06 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 3 个充电位：column 50 cm

选择 **column 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **128.78 分钟**，比第二名 vee 50 cm 少 87.29 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是优化分组后，两组双机充电任务中较长的一组；最后完成的充电位承担 P4、P5。

Column 在纵向形成连续遮挡，也使各位置依次受到前方机体与尾流影响。遮挡与不均匀旋翼来流共同作用，可以形成部分位置负担低、个别位置负担高的分布；顺风时不能照搬逆风的领航机解释。

与 vee 50 cm 相比，column 50 cm 的计算总时间减少 87.29 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 11.432 个百分点，对方为 16.553 个百分点，较低 30.9%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P4+P5，充电 128.36 分钟；对方承担 P4+P5，充电 129.82 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

### 4 个充电位：column 50 cm

选择 **column 50 cm**，计算总时间为 **127.45 分钟**，比第二名 echelon 50 cm 少 113.24 秒。在这一充电位数量下，关键是两个最短任务共享充电位的时间；最后完成的充电位承担 P3、P4。

Column 在纵向形成连续遮挡，也使各位置依次受到前方机体与尾流影响。遮挡与不均匀旋翼来流共同作用，可以形成部分位置负担低、个别位置负担高的分布；顺风时不能照搬逆风的领航机解释。

与 echelon 50 cm 相比，column 50 cm 的计算总时间减少 113.24 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 11.432 个百分点，对方为 15.174 个百分点，较低 24.7%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P3+P4，充电 127.03 分钟；对方承担 P3+P4，充电 128.92 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R4](https://hiperlab.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/Modeling_of_aerodynamic_disturbances_for_proximity_flight_of_multirotors.pdf) [R5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02992) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

Echelon 的侧向错位改变顺风搬运的尾流与相邻旋翼相遇的位置。相比直线 Column，这种几何变化可以重新分配各机负担，尤其影响最大耗电率及最后完成充电的无人机。

## 与其他队形比较：不能把时间优势全叫作省电优势

30 个决策分别与其他四种 formation 的最佳可用间距比较，共 120 组；另有 99 组固定间距比较，缺失和安全排除的组合不补造。120 组中有 8 组，选中的配置全队标准化耗电更高，但总时间仍更短；这是充电负担分布的优势。这些比较复用了同一批耗电率，不是 120 次独立实验。

例如低强度逆风、五个充电位：Echelon 75 cm 的全队 25 秒标准化消耗为 14.601 个百分点，Front 75 cm 为 9.687；然而前者最大位置耗电率更低，因此总时间快 41.02 秒。同一风况只有一个充电位时，Front 75 cm 又成为最优。

## 方法备注：部分配置的计算时间非常接近

五个充电位时，低强度侧风第一名只比第二名快 1.50 秒，高强度顺风只快 0.68 秒。这些应描述为结果接近，不写成大幅领先。下图展示六种风况在五位充电时的第一、第二名时间差。

已有逐次删除完整飞行的检查显示，30 个状态中有 25 个会在某次删除后改变选择；这反映了重复实验均值对排名的影响。详细检查与正文的物理解释分开呈现。

## 方法备注：以完整飞行为单位复核结果

此前复核以整次飞行为单位联合重抽样五个位置，保留同次飞行内的关联。每种风况尝试 2,000 次，候选位置数据完整的有效次数为 1,162–1,863。表中展示原配置在有效重抽样中被保留的频率，以及逐次删除完整飞行后的保留次数。只有一次观测的位置不能凭重抽样增加独立信息；电池标定和空间风场误差未在其中传播。

## 方法备注：充电模型检查与间距对照

此前分别改用恒流充电到 99%、指数充电到 80% 和 90%，三组检查均保持当前 30 个配置选择，但绝对时间不同。这不把假定的充电曲线变成实测曲线。

25 组具有两个间距数据的 formation–风况组合中，75 cm 的平均耗电率更低有 12 组，最大耗电率更低也有 12 组。因此当前数据并不呈现所有条件下 75 cm 都优于 50 cm 的规律。

## 当前进展怎样向老师汇报，之后怎样接入动态决策

当前已经完成：从处理后的真实数据计算 Medium 逐位置耗电率，统一 Bideal 起点，建立三输入配置函数，并给出数据和气动机理相结合的理由。主要结论是：风决定逐位置负担，充电位数量决定哪种负担分布能最小化总时间。

接下来若回到动态任务，则把当前五架无人机各自的 SOC 代入同一条“耗电率→到达 SOC→充电排程→总时间”计算链。本次固定起点的 decision map 不能直接替代不相等 SOC 下的选择。后续还需要明确实际充电曲线、配置切换时间以及跨段目标如何进入总时间；本中文版本不新增训练或修改这些假设。

query.sql:
-- Source: all 275 frozen candidate scores; no simulated flights.
-- The original charging calculation is separately documented and audited.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY charging_pad_availability, wind_direction, wind_level
    ORDER BY total_time_seconds, formation, inter_drone_spacing_cm
  ) AS computed_rank
  FROM candidate_rankings
)
SELECT b.charging_pad_availability AS charging_pads,
       b.wind_direction,
       CASE b.wind_level WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'high' END AS wind_strength,
       CASE b.formation WHEN 'echalon' THEN 'echelon' ELSE b.formation END
           || ' ' || b.inter_drone_spacing_cm || ' cm' AS configuration,
       b.total_time_seconds / 60.0 AS total_time_min,
       r.total_time_seconds - b.total_time_seconds AS gap_s,
       CASE r.formation WHEN 'echalon' THEN 'echelon' ELSE r.formation END
           || ' ' || r.inter_drone_spacing_cm || ' cm' AS runner_up,
       b.min_position_run_count AS min_trials
FROM ranked AS b
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON b.charging_pad_availability = r.charging_pad_availability
 AND b.wind_direction = r.wind_direction
 AND b.wind_level = r.wind_level
 AND r.computed_rank = 2
WHERE b.computed_rank = 1
ORDER BY b.wind_direction, b.wind_level, b.charging_pad_availability;

query.sql:
-- Whole-trial resampling is produced by interpret_medium_decisions.py.
-- Reconcile leave-one-out denominators directly from the deletion-level audit.
WITH deletion_counts AS (
  SELECT key,
         SUM(CASE WHEN evaluable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_deletions,
         SUM(CASE WHEN evaluable = 1 AND retained = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_deletions
  FROM leave_one_trial_out
  GROUP BY key
)
SELECT s.key, s.bootstrap_attempts, s.bootstrap_valid, s.bootstrap_invalid,
       s.nominal_winner_selection_frequency,
       d.valid_deletions, d.retained_deletions,
       1.0 * d.retained_deletions / NULLIF(d.valid_deletions, 0) AS deletion_retention_fraction
FROM resampling_sensitivity AS s
JOIN deletion_counts AS d ON s.key = d.key
ORDER BY s.key;

query.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY charging_pad_availability, wind_direction, wind_level, formation
    ORDER BY total_time_seconds, inter_drone_spacing_cm
  ) AS formation_rank FROM candidate_rankings
)
SELECT s.charging_pad_availability AS charging_pads, s.wind_direction, s.wind_level,
s.formation AS selected_formation,
s.inter_drone_spacing_cm AS selected_spacing_cm,
s.total_time_seconds AS selected_total_time_s,
s.charging_seconds_by_position AS selected_charging_seconds,
s.charging_pad_groups AS selected_pad_groups,
s.charging_pad_loads_seconds AS selected_pad_loads_s,
ps.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p1_rate,
ps.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p2_rate,
ps.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p3_rate,
ps.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p4_rate,
ps.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p5_rate,
(ps.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min) * 25.0 / 60.0 AS selected_swarm_drop_pp,
c.formation AS comparator_formation,
c.inter_drone_spacing_cm AS comparator_spacing_cm,
c.total_time_seconds AS comparator_total_time_s,
c.charging_seconds_by_position AS comparator_charging_seconds,
c.charging_pad_groups AS comparator_pad_groups,
c.charging_pad_loads_seconds AS comparator_pad_loads_s,
pc.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p1_rate,
pc.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p2_rate,
pc.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p3_rate,
pc.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p4_rate,
pc.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p5_rate,
(pc.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min) * 25.0 / 60.0 AS comparator_swarm_drop_pp
FROM ranked s JOIN ranked c
 ON s.charging_pad_availability = c.charging_pad_availability
 AND s.wind_direction = c.wind_direction AND s.wind_level = c.wind_level
 AND s.formation != c.formation
JOIN profiles ps ON ps.wind_direction = s.wind_direction AND ps.wind_level = s.wind_level
 AND ps.formation = s.formation AND ps.inter_drone_spacing_cm = s.inter_drone_spacing_cm
JOIN profiles pc ON pc.wind_direction = c.wind_direction AND pc.wind_level = c.wind_level
 AND pc.formation = c.formation AND pc.inter_drone_spacing_cm = c.inter_drone_spacing_cm
WHERE s.rank = 1 AND c.formation_rank = 1
ORDER BY s.wind_direction, s.wind_level, s.charging_pad_availability, c.total_time_seconds, c.formation;

decisions.explanation_en: With 1 available charging pad, front 75 cm gives the lowest computed total time (322.08 min), 219.51 s below echelon 75 cm. It minimizes the sum of all five charging times; the limiting pad serves P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and finishes charging after 321.66 min. A transverse front row avoids a streamwise chain of followers; lateral separation controls neighbouring wake overlap and induced-flow loading. Compared with the best available echelon 75 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 9.687 versus 14.601 pp over 25 s (33.7% lower). The time advantage accompanies lower aggregate discharge. Front keeps the drones at one longitudinal station, whereas echelon staggers successive drones both laterally and longitudinally. The transverse row avoids a direct follower chain; the diagonal layout changes wake-core versus wake-edge exposure. These two mechanisms need not produce the same total discharge or the same worst-position discharge. [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)
decisions.explanation_zh: 1个充电位时选front 75 cm：计算总时间322.08分钟，比第二名echelon 75 cm少219.51秒；最后完成的充电位承担P1, P2, P3, P4, P5，该位充电负担为321.66分钟。
decisions.caveats: The selected profile includes 1 flat-SOC trace(s); an integer gauge plateau does not imply zero physical energy use. Whole-trial resampling retained this numerical winner in 80.6% of 1765 evaluable draws; this is not a confidence probability.

与 echelon 75 cm 相比，front 75 cm 的计算总时间减少 219.51 秒。25 秒内五架无人机的标准化 SOC 消耗之和为 9.687 个百分点，对方为 14.601 个百分点，较低 33.7%。这组比较中，总时间优势伴随着更低的全队标准化耗电。最终完成充电的充电位分别承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 321.66 分钟；对方承担 P1+P2+P3+P4+P5，充电 325.32 分钟。两者间距相同。 [R6](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-024-03880-3) [R10](https://elib.dlr.de/207785/1/s9.pdf)

decisions.explanation_en: With 2 available charging pads, front 75 cm gives the lowest computed total time (190.77 min), 169.77 s below front 50 cm. It minimizes the combined charging time of the three shortest charging jobs; the limiting pad serves P1, P3, P4 and finishes charging after 190.35 min. A transverse front row avoids a streamwise chain of followers; lateral separation controls neighbouring wake overlap and induced-flow loading. Compared with the best available column 50 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 9.687 versus 15.014 pp over 25 s (35.5% lower). The time advantage accompanies lower aggregate discharge. Front places neighbours side by side, whereas column puts them in a longitudinal chain. It minimizes the longest individual charging time; the limiting pad serves P4 and finishes charging after 65.47 min. Staggering can reduce direct downwash exposure by shifting downstream rotors laterally relative to upstream wake cores. Compared with the best available vee 75 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 14.601 versus 17.351 pp over 25 s (15.9% lower). The different neighbour offsets change which wake regions intersect each rotor, so the two layouts can distribute motor demand differently even at the same nearest-neighbour spacing. The resulting inflow and force imbalance change rotor thrust production and the motor corrections needed to maintain the flight path. It minimizes the sum of all five charging times; the limiting pad serves P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and finishes charging after 322.92 min. tail_high.explanation_en: With 1 available charging pad, column 50 cm gives the lowest computed total time (323.33 min), 165.16 s below echelon 50 cm. It minimizes the sum of all five charging times; the limiting pad serves P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and finishes charging after 322.92 min. A wind-aligned column couples shielding and wake-induced thrust changes along the line; these mechanisms can create unequal position loads rather than uniform savings. Compared with the best available echelon 50 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 11.432 versus 15.174 pp over 25 s (24.7% lower). The time advantage accompanies lower aggregate discharge. Column repeats neighbours on one straight line; echelon adds lateral offset as well as longitudinal separation. This changes whether a downstream rotor samples the descending wake core or its edge, and therefore the rotor speed required to maintain thrust. Staggering also redistributes the moments that the attitude controller must correct. Its summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop over 25 s is 16.65 rather than 13.69 pp (21.6% higher). This is a charging-workload advantage, not an aggregate-discharge saving. The last-finishing charging pad serves P1 (66.15 min), compared with P2 (66.17 min) for front 50 cm. The maximum position rate is 10.82 versus 10.91 Bideal pp/min; with five pads this maximum sets completion. The front row lies along the lateral wind component, allowing serial sheltering but also repeated wake encounters; the column is transverse to that component, exposing its members more independently. Sheltering changes the thrust needed to resist drag, while wake encounters change the rotor effort needed to produce that thrust. This best-configuration contrast changes spacing as well as formation; the matched-spacing companion separates the geometry comparison. Its summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop over 25 s is 15.05 rather than 17.92 pp (16.0% lower). The selected configuration therefore has lower aggregate normalized discharge in this comparison. The last-finishing charging pad serves P1 (65.86 min), compared with P2 (67.26 min) for echelon 50 cm. The maximum position rate is 9.77 versus 14.98 Bideal pp/min; with five pads this maximum sets completion. Echelon shifts successive neighbours laterally along a diagonal; diamond retains centre-line fore-aft interactions as well as lateral neighbours. The diagonal can move rotors away from direct wake cores, whereas the diamond combines this lateral offset with sheltered centre-line positions. In tailwind, wake convection can reverse the upstream-downstream order relative to headwind. The resulting inflow and force imbalance change rotor thrust production and the motor corrections needed to maintain the flight path. This best-configuration contrast changes spacing as well as formation; the matched-spacing companion separates the geometry comparison. cross_formation_best_available_spacing.explanation_en: Against echelon 50 cm, column 50 cm reduces computed total time by 165.16 s. Its summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop over 25 s is 11.43 rather than 15.17 pp (24.7% lower). The selected configuration therefore has lower aggregate normalized discharge in this comparison. five_pad_gaps.explanation_en: With 5 available charging pads, diamond 75 cm gives the lowest computed total time (66.27 min), 17.67 s below column 75 cm. It minimizes the longest individual charging time; the limiting pad serves P1 and finishes charging after 65.86 min. Diamond geometry distributes positions both along and across the airflow, combining sheltered locations with laterally offset rotor inflow. Compared with the best available column 75 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 15.047 versus 16.427 pp over 25 s (8.4% lower). The time advantage accompanies lower aggregate discharge. Column repeats neighbours along a single longitudinal line; diamond spreads them across both horizontal axes while retaining centre-line interactions. This redistributes sheltering and wake-induced loading between central and lateral positions. In tailwind, wake convection can reverse the upstream-downstream order relative to headwind. The resulting inflow and force imbalance change rotor thrust production and the motor corrections needed to maintain the flight path. stability.explanation_en: With 1 available charging pad, front 75 cm gives the lowest computed total time (322.08 min), 219.51 s below echelon 75 cm. It minimizes the sum of all five charging times; the limiting pad serves P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and finishes charging after 321.66 min. A transverse front row avoids a streamwise chain of followers; lateral separation controls neighbouring wake overlap and induced-flow loading. Compared with the best available echelon 75 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 9.687 versus 14.601 pp over 25 s (33.7% lower). These two mechanisms need not produce the same total discharge or the same worst-position discharge. stability.explanation_en: With 5 available charging pads, column 75 cm gives the lowest computed total time (66.56 min), 1.50 s below front 50 cm. stability.explanation_en: With 1 available charging pad, column 50 cm gives the lowest computed total time (323.33 min), 165.16 s below echelon 50 cm. It minimizes the sum of all five charging times; the limiting pad serves P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and finishes charging after 322.92 min. Column 在纵向形成连续遮挡，也使各位置依次受到前方机体与尾流影响。遮挡与不均匀旋翼来流共同作用，可以形成部分位置负担低、个别位置负担高的分布；顺风时不能照搬逆风的领航机解释。

A wind-aligned column couples shielding and wake-induced thrust changes along the line; these mechanisms can create unequal position loads rather than uniform savings. Compared with the best available echelon 50 cm, the selected profile has a summed five-drone Bideal SOC drop of 11.432 versus 15.174 pp over 25 s (24.7% lower). The time advantage accompanies lower aggregate discharge. Column repeats neighbours on one straight line; echelon adds lateral offset as well as longitudinal separation. This changes whether a downstream rotor samples the descending wake core or its edge, and therefore the rotor speed required to maintain thrust. Staggering also redistributes the moments that the attitude controller must correct. sources.label: Frozen Medium configuration decisions and candidate profiles

query.engine: SQLite in memory; upstream Python / NumPy charging audit
query.sql:
-- Source: all 275 frozen candidate scores; no simulated flights.
-- The original charging calculation is separately documented and audited.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY charging_pad_availability, wind_direction, wind_level
    ORDER BY total_time_seconds, formation, inter_drone_spacing_cm
  ) AS computed_rank
  FROM candidate_rankings
)
SELECT b.charging_pad_availability AS charging_pads,
       b.wind_direction,
       CASE b.wind_level WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'high' END AS wind_strength,
       CASE b.formation WHEN 'echalon' THEN 'echelon' ELSE b.formation END
           || ' ' || b.inter_drone_spacing_cm || ' cm' AS configuration,
       b.total_time_seconds / 60.0 AS total_time_min,
       r.total_time_seconds - b.total_time_seconds AS gap_s,
       CASE r.formation WHEN 'echalon' THEN 'echelon' ELSE r.formation END
           || ' ' || r.inter_drone_spacing_cm || ' cm' AS runner_up,
       b.min_position_run_count AS min_trials
FROM ranked AS b
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON b.charging_pad_availability = r.charging_pad_availability
 AND b.wind_direction = r.wind_direction
 AND b.wind_level = r.wind_level
 AND r.computed_rank = 2
WHERE b.computed_rank = 1
ORDER BY b.wind_direction, b.wind_level, b.charging_pad_availability;
query.description: SQL independently ranks all 275 frozen candidate scores and computes the 30 winning margins. Upstream discharge normalization and charging schedules are audited in interpret_medium_decisions.py; no real records or winners change.
filters: Real 250 cm forward-flight Medium data only; no wind-tunnel or synthetic flights
Fixed preprocessed Bideal SOC 75%; duration 25 s; identical available pads
Four safety exclusions; one further cell lacks real data

metric_definitions.gap_s: Second-smallest minus smallest computed total time, seconds
metric_definitions.min_trials: Smallest usable real-run count among the five positions of the selected configuration

sources.label: Whole-trial resampling and leave-one-trial-out audit

query.engine: SQLite in memory; upstream Python / NumPy resampling
query.sql:
-- Whole-trial resampling is produced by interpret_medium_decisions.py.
-- Reconcile leave-one-out denominators directly from the deletion-level audit.
WITH deletion_counts AS (
  SELECT key,
         SUM(CASE WHEN evaluable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_deletions,
         SUM(CASE WHEN evaluable = 1 AND retained = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_deletions
  FROM leave_one_trial_out
  GROUP BY key
)
SELECT s.key, s.bootstrap_attempts, s.bootstrap_valid, s.bootstrap_invalid,
       s.nominal_winner_selection_frequency,
       d.valid_deletions, d.retained_deletions,
       1.0 * d.retained_deletions / NULLIF(d.valid_deletions, 0) AS deletion_retention_fraction
FROM resampling_sensitivity AS s
JOIN deletion_counts AS d ON s.key = d.key
ORDER BY s.key;
query.description: SQL recomputes deletion denominators and retention from the deletion-level audit and joins reviewed bootstrap results. Reproducible companion output_py/interpret_medium_decisions.py; 2,000 whole-trial bootstrap attempts per wind condition, seed 20260909.

metric_definitions.resampling_frequency: Fraction of evaluable bootstrap draws in which the nominal winner remains a minimum; not a posterior probability
metric_definitions.valid_draws: Draws retaining at least one usable observation for every candidate-position; incomplete draws are excluded and counted
metric_definitions.loo_retained: Evaluable whole-flight deletions, within the wind condition, preserving the nominal winner

sources.label: Cross-formation comparison: best available spacing

query.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY charging_pad_availability, wind_direction, wind_level, formation
    ORDER BY total_time_seconds, inter_drone_spacing_cm
  ) AS formation_rank FROM candidate_rankings
)
SELECT s.charging_pad_availability AS charging_pads, s.wind_direction, s.wind_level,
s.formation AS selected_formation,
s.inter_drone_spacing_cm AS selected_spacing_cm,
s.total_time_seconds AS selected_total_time_s,
s.charging_seconds_by_position AS selected_charging_seconds,
s.charging_pad_groups AS selected_pad_groups,
s.charging_pad_loads_seconds AS selected_pad_loads_s,
ps.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p1_rate,
ps.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p2_rate,
ps.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p3_rate,
ps.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p4_rate,
ps.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS selected_p5_rate,
(ps.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + ps.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min) * 25.0 / 60.0 AS selected_swarm_drop_pp,
c.formation AS comparator_formation,
c.inter_drone_spacing_cm AS comparator_spacing_cm,
c.total_time_seconds AS comparator_total_time_s,
c.charging_seconds_by_position AS comparator_charging_seconds,
c.charging_pad_groups AS comparator_pad_groups,
c.charging_pad_loads_seconds AS comparator_pad_loads_s,
pc.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p1_rate,
pc.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p2_rate,
pc.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p3_rate,
pc.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p4_rate,
pc.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min AS comparator_p5_rate,
(pc.position_1_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_2_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_3_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_4_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min + pc.position_5_discharge_rate_Bideal_pp_min) * 25.0 / 60.0 AS comparator_swarm_drop_pp
FROM ranked s JOIN ranked c
 ON s.charging_pad_availability = c.charging_pad_availability
 AND s.wind_direction = c.wind_direction AND s.wind_level = c.wind_level
 AND s.formation != c.formation
JOIN profiles ps ON ps.wind_direction = s.wind_direction AND ps.wind_level = s.wind_level
 AND ps.formation = s.formation AND ps.inter_drone_spacing_cm = s.inter_drone_spacing_cm
JOIN profiles pc ON pc.wind_direction = c.wind_direction AND pc.wind_level = c.wind_level
 AND pc.formation = c.formation AND pc.inter_drone_spacing_cm = c.inter_drone_spacing_cm
WHERE s.rank = 1 AND c.formation_rank = 1
ORDER BY s.wind_direction, s.wind_level, s.charging_pad_availability, c.total_time_seconds, c.formation;
query.description: Executed join of frozen optimizer scores and five-position Medium rates. The winner is compared with each other formation at its best available spacing, or at matching spacing.
filters: Same wind direction, wind level and available charging-pad count

metric_definitions.gap_s: Comparator minus selected total time in seconds
metric_definitions.selected_swarm_drop_pp: Sum of five selected Bideal position rates times 25/60; percentage points
metric_definitions.comparator_swarm_drop_pp: Sum of five comparator Bideal position rates times 25/60; percentage points
metric_definitions.rate_profile: P1-P5 Bideal percentage points per minute
